# PimSuea — llms.txt
# https://pimsuea.com/llms.txt
# Last updated: 2026-11-24

> PimSuea is a Bangkok-based print-on-demand platform for custom t-shirts in Thailand.
> Design online in English or Thai, see live THB pricing, order from 1 piece with no minimum,
> pay by card or PromptPay, get English support on LINE. DTG printing in Bangkok,
> delivery to all 77 provinces in 5–14 days.

## Who it is for

- Expat and foreigner activity clubs in Thailand: run clubs, ice bath / breathwork groups, Muay Thai gyms, Hash House Harriers, padel and football teams
- International companies and teams in Thailand: offsites, onboarding, events
- Digital nomads, coworking and coliving communities, creators and personal brands
- Crypto and Web3 communities: meetup, conference and community merch in small runs
- Couples and families: matching shirts for trips, weddings, Songkran, birthdays; gift box add-on
- Thai creators, brands, clubs and companies

## Why people in Thailand choose it

- No Thai required: self-serve English studio and checkout, English support on LINE
- No minimum order: 1 shirt to 100+
- Price up front: live per-piece THB quote before paying, no quote requests
- Local, not imported: printed in Bangkok, priced in THB, no international shipping or import duty (unlike Printful or overseas sites)

## Canonical facts

- Brand: PimSuea
- Website: https://pimsuea.com (English) · https://pimsuea.com/th (Thai)
- App (design & order): https://app.pimsuea.com/catalog
- Location: Bangkok, Thailand — serves all 77 provinces, including Chiang Mai, Phuket, Pattaya, Hua Hin, Koh Samui and Koh Phangan
- Printing: DTG (Direct to Garment), no minimum order
- Volume: 200+ shirts printed (as of Nov 2026) for Thai customers, expats, student clubs (e.g. IBC Basketball Club), fashion brands (e.g. ABG #SamyanABG) and companies (e.g. Issa Compass, Tevox Automotive)
- Pricing: Live per-piece quote in the design studio (THB)
- Lead time: 5–14 days typical; transit time varies by location
- Payment: card and PromptPay, priced in THB
- Languages: English and Thai (site, studio, and LINE support)

## Example pricing snapshot (2026-11-28, from Supabase)

Classic DTG tee garment (White, qty 1–11): 199 THB
Classic DTG tee garment (Other colors, qty 1–11): 219 THB
Oversized boxy tee (White, qty 1–11): 390 THB
Oversized boxy tee (Other colors, qty 1–11): 420 THB
Essential long sleeve cotton tee (White, qty 1–11): 450 THB
Essential long sleeve cotton tee (Other colors, qty 1–11): 480 THB
DTG print smallest tier 3×4" (White, qty 1–11): 99 THB
DTG print smallest tier 3×4" (Other colors, qty 1–11): 129 THB
Example starting total: ~298 THB per piece (classic white tee + small print)
Delivery: 50 THB (1–5 pcs), 100 THB (6–10 pcs), 100 THB (11+ pcs)
